note: Icare Clinic (ikiavisioncenter.com) redesign pitch "Iris Noir": illustrative eye-care imagery ADDED by the redesign (fal flux-pro ultra stills, birefnet cut-outs, Higgsfield Kling image-to-video loops). Generated people are generic illustrative models only: never Dr. Ike Ikechi, staff, patients or the Houston office, never a real result of this practice. No text, no logos, no brand names. Real Icare Clinic photos and brand art are harvested separately into assets/source/ and assets/brand/. defaults.style is appended to every prompt by tools/fal-gen.mjs; the two CUT-* items are generated from tmp/img/plan-cutouts.json instead (same ids, files and prompts, a light-grey product style), because the dark tenebrist ground would defeat the matting. The two kind:video items are optional so that a bare fal-gen run never sends them to fal.
